new_events.actor: UK Maritime Trade Operations / reporting merchant-vessel master
new_events.summary: UKMTO Warning 191-26: a merchant-vessel master relayed a VHF Ch16 Mayday stating another vessel was hit by an unknown projectile in Strait of Hormuz. Warning confirms receipt of report, not independently authenticated hull, crew status, casualties, fire, attacker, weapon or BDA. Do not merge with 192-26, earlier RITI, LOUISE 1, ARZANAH or AL MAYEDA.
